name: agent-delegation
description: Delegates long-running coding and research tasks to the OpenCode, Antigravity (agy) and Codex CLIs as unattended MCP subagents. Dispatch returns a run id immediately and records the run on disk, so a delegate stays reachable - checkable, tailable, cancellable - across dropped connections, session ends and server restarts. Fails fast on provider quota walls instead of blocking for the full hour, kills hung delegates on an idle timer, and reports whatever the delegate wrote to .agent-runs/ on every exit path. quota_status reports agy, Codex and opencode quota in one table. Web research is handed to you as a ready-to-run Gemini prompt (the gemini-ask skill).
